title: Multi-Concept Customization of Text-to-Image Diffusion
layout_note: Two titled halves side by side: 'Training Dataset' at left, a 2x2 grid of photo pairs with rotated row labels 'New concepts' and 'Retrieved similar images'; 'Fine-Tuning' at right, a grey rounded U-Net container between a noisy input photo x_t and a cleaner photo x_{t-1}, a token row and Text transformer above it, and a Trainable/Frozen key at top-right.
grouping: No frames between the halves (whitespace and large titles). In the fine-tuning half a light-grey rounded container labelled 'Diffusion Model U-Net' holds ResNet and Attention blocks; each Attention block is a rounded frame holding stacked KV and Q boxes.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles in pale blue-grey (frozen) and tan (trainable), thin dark outlines; tokens are small vertical rounded rectangles with rotated monospace words (photo, of, a, V*, dog), the V* token tan. Photos have thin black borders with monospace captions beneath (V* dog, Moongate, Dog, Cute dog, Wisdom moon, Gated entry).
proposed_highlight: Tan 'Trainable' fill, keyed at top-right, marks exactly what the method updates: the KV boxes inside each Attention block and the V* token.
lesson: Show which weights are trained by drawing them inside their block (a tan KV box stacked on a frozen Q box) and give the new token the same trainable fill, so one keyed colour tells the whole fine-tuning story.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv v2 first page states no venue; the candidate list gives CVPR 2023 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year. id uses the caption's name 'Custom Diffusion'. flow 'mixed': the U-Net runs left to right from x_t to x_{t-1}, text enters from the top. Photos are embedded images (photo_share). Figure 4 of the paper opens the cross-attention (W^q frozen, W^k and W^v trainable) and was not carded.

arrangement.units: two titled halves without frames: a 2x2 photo-pair grid with rotated row labels (training data), and a grey rounded U-Net container with token row, text transformer and key (fine-tuning)
arrangement.inputs_as: real photos with monospace captions in a grid; in the fine-tuning half a noisy photo x_t at the left and a tokenised prompt 'photo of a V* dog' at the top
arrangement.losses_at: no objective is drawn; the denoising target is implied by the x_t to x_{t-1} photos on either side of the U-Net
arrangement.shared: the Text transformer's output reaches every Attention block's KV box by elbow arrows from one bar

taxonomy.task: customising a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model to new concepts by fine-tuning only cross-attention key/value weights and a new token, regularised with retrieved real images

insights.structure: A data half and a model half sit side by side under large titles; inside the model half the U-Net is a grey container of ResNet and Attention blocks with an ellipsis for depth.
insights.data: Training data are real photo pairs with monospace captions, split into new-concept and retrieved rows; the prompt is a row of rotated word tokens; the denoising step is a noisy and a cleaner photo on either side of the U-Net.
insights.emphasis: One keyed tan fill marks every trained part (KV boxes and the V* token), against pale blue-grey for everything frozen.
insights.flow: Text goes down from the token row through the Text transformer into each KV box by elbow arrows; the image goes left to right through the U-Net container.
insights.avoid: The data half is not connected to the fine-tuning half by any arrow, and retrieval is shown only as its result (a row of photos), not as a step.

core.what: inside each Attention block of the drawn U-Net, a tan trainable KV box sits on a pale frozen Q box, so which weights are fine-tuned is shown inside the architecture

relations.form: each Attention block is a rounded frame holding a tan KV box over a pale Q box, repeated in two blocks with an ellipsis between
noisy photo x_t at the left of the U-Net container, cleaner photo x_{t-1} at the right, ResNet and Attention blocks between
the tokenised prompt with a tan V* token passes through a Text transformer bar whose output drops by elbow arrows into each KV box
a second photo row 'Retrieved similar images' under the 'New concepts' row, each retrieved photo captioned with its text (Dog, Cute dog, Wisdom moon, Gated entry)
each new-concept photo pair sits directly above its retrieved pair in the same column (V* dog over Dog/Cute dog, Moongate over Wisdom moon/Gated entry)

channels.colour: tan = trainable, pale blue-grey = frozen (keyed at top-right); one meaning, applied to both weights and the V* token
channels.shape: rounded rectangles = modules, small vertical rounded rectangles = tokens, bordered photos = data
channels.line: solid arrows = text conditioning into KV; no other line types
channels.frame: grey rounded container = the U-Net; rounded frame = one Attention block

quality.strengths: Which weights are trained is drawn inside the block (KV tan, Q frozen) with one keyed colour that also marks the new token; data are real captioned photos, with new concepts directly above their retrieved counterparts; the denoising step is shown as photos on either side of the U-Net.
quality.weaknesses: Nothing connects the data half to the fine-tuning half, and retrieval appears only as its output; the elbow arrows from the Text transformer to the far KV box run across the top of the U-Net; the regularisation role of the retrieved row is left to the caption.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
